critical_issues: No visible ripples, meniscus, or bubbles—key interaction cues are missing or lost to clipping.
warnings: Reduce exposure substantially (e.g., -2 to -4 stops) and/or reduce light intensities by ~5–20× until the glass silhouette and oil color are readable.
Avoid a pure-white background/overpowering backlight; introduce controlled rim lighting and a slightly darker background to separate the stream and glass edges.
Ensure the oil material has visible absorption/tint (amber-gold) so it reads against the background; make sure transmission/refraction highlights are not clipping.
Add/adjust lighting to create specular rims on the glass (edge highlights) and visible refractive distortion through the cylinder.
Verify the simulation mesh is actually visible in render (not hidden/fully transparent) and that the stream intersects the glass opening at the intended height.
Render the full frame range (1–48) so temporal criteria (continuous pour, rising level, ripple damping, occasional bubbles) can be judged.
